ينخفض (form VII)
# يَنْخَفِضُ (yanḵafiḍu) /jan.xa.fi.dˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
# يَنْخَفِضَ (yanḵafiḍa) /jan.xa.fi.dˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
# يَنْخَفِضْ (yanḵafiḍ) /jan.xa.fidˤ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
